title: eGurukul · Lichen Planus

questions.stem: A 35 years old female came to dermatology OPD with complaints of multiple pruritic follicular keratotic and spinous papules all over the body and scarring alopecia of the scalp for 4 years. On examination, dilated follicular orifices plugged with keratotic debris were seen with marked perifollicular violaceous hyperpigmentation and complete loss of hair. Axillary and pubic hair were sparse with a history of recurrent episodic shedding for the last 3 years. Histopathological examination shows marked hypergranulosis along with the presence of vacuolar degeneration and apoptotic keratinocytes. What is the likely diagnosis?
